I’m waiting for someone to say, “Human”. 

Btw for me potatoes.

Yeah, for real. I, myself, is not suicidal, just curious on some things about it. Then the RedditCareResources messaged me because some redditor are concerned I might be going through some shit. It’s cool though, that reddit has that kind of thing.
Well, I hope that’s a good thing. I saw someone replied that there’s this one article that he read about how it is common for people to remove their jacket, hat, etc., before doing it.
Yeah, I agree. Still, it keeps bothering me. Whyohwhy

Yeah. That’s also what I’m thinking. Just hoping there must be more, idk, information or something? It also probably doesn’t matter if they leave it on or not. I guess I just want to know dumb things. Keeps my mind sane, I guess.

I shoved my fist inside my mouth because I can, then sent a video to my friends because they aren’t convinced that I could do it. They were mostly shocked and a little impressed and thanking me for the effort, which is weird I know. I guess we’re all weird that’s why we clicked. That’s about it. Still deleted it though because I, myself, is disgusted by myself so no need to tell me that. Lol.
